title: Lost submarines like the USS Connecticut

tellings.quote: and there all these lost submarines like the USS Connecticut where it's like we don't really know what happened.

plain: Michels says in passing that there have been a lot of lost submarines, and he gives the USS Connecticut, a US Navy submarine, as an example of a case where "we don't really know what happened." He tells it himself, without naming a source, as a hint that strange things go on in the deep ocean.
